exposure: Obstetrical complications (gestational diabetes mellitus, preeclampsia, placenta previa, oligohydramnios, premature rupture of membrane, breech presentation, multiparity, nuchal cord)
Maternal factors (weight before pregnancy, gestational weight gain, maternal age)
cohort: 10517 neonatal births (7787 term singletons and 169 term twins).
finding: In term gestation, obstetric complications were significantly associated with singleton birth size rather than twin birth size.
